components.name: Toggle
components.description:
Figma Toggle (1526:5703, page ❖ Toggle): a ToggleButton beside its Content, a label (Body/Base/Regular, Bold with
`bold`, Content/Neutral/Strongest) and an optional caption (Caption/Regular, Content/Neutral/Light), Spacing/Gap/Medium
apart (Small: Gap/Small). Theme text-first puts the label before the switch, as in a settings row; toggle-first after.
It applies at once: no Save.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the switch is flipped.

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling. XLarge (`xl`) is the 48px switch with an icon in its dot.

props.name: icon
props.description:
XLarge only (Figma Icon + Icon-Src): an icon in the dot, an icon name (`"icon-moon-01-line"`) or a node. It takes
 Toggle/Dot/Content/Unselected (Light) while off and /Selected (Strongest) while on; smaller dots have no room for
 it and leave it out.

props.name: ref
props.description: The element with role="switch" (the one that takes focus); the native checkbox inside only carries the form value.

props.name: caption
props.description: Toggle (1526:5703) Content Subtext: short help under the label (Caption/Regular 11/16, Content/Neutral/Light).

components.name: ToggleButton
components.description:
Figma Toggle-Button (1523:104, page ❖ Toggle): the switch alone. A track two dots wide plus Spacing/Padding/3XSmall
around a dot of Toggle/Item/Size (Small 12 · Medium 16 · Large 20 · XLarge 44, with an icon in its dot); the track
takes Toggle/Bar/Background/Unselected|Seclected (Default, Hover, Disabled), the dot Toggle/Dot/Background. Select=Yes
slides the dot to the end. Name it with `aria-label` or a visible label (`aria-labelledby`); Toggle adds that label.
